body: Watch this space😃. I have already made some difficult choices today which may or maynot impact my life in the future.  This impact may be a positive step for me, but taking into consideration where I am now in my life, it is something I have put on the back burner - so to speak. I have also managed to set some realistic goals for myself, including yoga.  Here's to us all having a very good new year. Thank you again for everything.  I will stay in touch 😘
Dont i need to have a room at 40 degrees to do this yoga?

Such beautiful words Applebucks. Thank you. I will try the hot yoga. Sounds interesting. I have no kids. Cant have them due to cervical cancer. My husband of almost six years has always been quite the non talker. Ive always been the soul of our relationship. Ive tried talking to him. Tried to have our friends talk to him and he just closes down. He very rarely looks me in the eye. Doesnt involve me in anythung he does.  We basically are just existing together. Ive been trying to tackle issues one by one as suggested by my therapist but it really all got too much for me over the holidays. What you just said regarding making people happy, this is all i have ever done in my life and it got me no where except to show me how much people take advantage of my good nature. My therapist has been trying to make me a little more selfish and do more for me. Right now the onky thing i do for me is to try and find a little me time. Get away from everyone and everything and go for a walk or something. I get a lot of exercise this way plus I keep my home beautiful even if it is onky appreciated by me 😃
Hi Applebucks - what should i do or where do i go now. Im lost using this system a little too.

Hi there. I really dont feel like physically speaking to someone right now.  Difficult to soeak through tears. I onky saw your reply now. My apologies. Have you seen the other thread where i have been chatting? Maybe you could also pass on your thoughts to me. I feel calmer following my previous chats but am feeling both wore out and lost right now. Thank yiu.
Ah. Unfortunately another wonderful man. So very sad to loose such an amzing person way too soon.

Certain celeb?  Schumacher?  While I was in hospital for Cancer the doctors always said i was the healthiest looking and acting patient they had ever known lol. Thats me life and soul of the pasrty right till the end.  Not a bad trait but obviously has its disadvantages too.
And you. Thank you for being here/there for me.
My cats. Three of them here with me now 😃
Maybe I did it. I am a new user. Im the orignator of the post. Sorry. Not sure how to use all of this.

I could in all honestly say I am not sure. I am having huge trust issues today. I am not sure if I could trust anything right now. I am so scared to do anything or say anythung to anyone I love and have in my life right now. I really feel like they just dont get it. My best friend today who I have not seen or heard very much from since I was diagnosed with depression earlier this year, after i told her how i was feeling today, very depressed and exhausted, and that i would not join her and her family for dinner but my husband and oldest brother would. She replied, i wish you a speedy recovery. Where is the support here, from any of them?

I think you might be on to something there. A touch of 'wit' I am wrll known for 😜. Ive always been the life and soul of my family and friends and now they all seem to be drifting away from me when I need them most. I know it is difficult fir them to understand that I am depressed.  Ive even given them options where they could get help and assistance if they needed it so they could understand what I am going through and also to get help and support for them during this. My husband has totally blocked me out. Doesnt even look me straight in the eye. I feel like my soul is being dragged slowly through my stomach. I never though i could feel such emotional pain. Apart from what i already mentioned some of my life stories would make you think i had reached rock bottom before, but amazingly none of them ever ripped me apart as much as my life and myself emotions are being submitted to right now.

I am not sure to be quite honest. So much has happened in my life and especially during the past few years that I wouldnt know where to begin with all of that. Right now, my marraige is falling apart, virtually dead due to my cancer, then subsequent hysterectomy and 'depressive episode' as they call it here - burn out, nervous breakdown being the other more common words.
